title: 97% of Day Traders Are Gone in 2 Years
hook: That trading app on your phone looks exactly like a game — and 97% of day traders lose money within two years.
angle: Day trading apps are casinos disguised as investing tools — they earn on every trade regardless of whether the user wins or loses, creating an inherent conflict of interest.
audience: Young investors tempted by Robinhood-style trading apps, anyone who has downloaded a stock trading app
key_numbers: 97% of persistent day traders lose money within 2 years (5-year Brazilian study)
Active traders underperform the market by 6.5% annually
$3,400 average day trader loss in year one on a $10,000 account
92% of professional fund managers underperform a simple index fund over 20 years
$0.10 per trade: what trading apps earn through payment for order flow
